subject.title: improve(ui): calmer sessions roster with dot status and drawer-level runtime

question: Should this PR's dot-plus-label status treatment and drawer-only Runtime placement become the accepted Sessions page UX direction now?
rationale: The patch is technically focused, but it changes visible Control UI scanning density and is linked to an open product-decision issue with a protected maintainer label.

options.title: Accept the focused polish
options.body: Merge the PR after normal exact-head checks because the implementation, screenshots, and tests match the requested Sessions UI direction.

options.title: Narrow the visual change
options.body: Ask the author to keep only the status treatment or only the Runtime relocation if maintainers want a smaller UX adjustment.

options.title: Defer the direction
options.body: Leave the current redesigned roster in place and keep the linked issue open for more operator feedback.

recommendation.title: Accept the focused polish
recommendation.body: Merge the PR after normal exact-head checks because the implementation, screenshots, and tests match the requested Sessions UI direction.
